/dev/sda = Your hard drive

/dev/sda1 = The first partition on your hard drive. On Windows, they are marked by letter C,D,E, etc., but on Linux they are marked /dev/sda1, /dev/sda2, /dev/sda3, etc. A partition is a section of your hard drive that is treated by most OSes as a separate drive in most but not all ways. If you only have one OS, odds are you only have one, but if you dual boot (have multiple OSes) you'd probably need more than one.
